MD. MAHBUBUR RAHMAN
Vs.
THE STATE
full_judgment:
Sheikh Abdul Awal, J: In this appeal under section 30 of the Special Powers Act, 1974 the accused-appellant prayed for bail in Metro. Special Tribunal Case No. 295 of 2016 arising out of Bimanbondar Police Station Case No. 33 dated 25.8.2015 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 494 of 2015 under section 25B 1(b)/25D of the Special Powers Act, 1974, now pending in the Court of the learned Metropolitan Special Tribunal No. 15, Dhaka. 

 3. Upon the aforesaid first information report Bimanbondar Police Station Case No. 33 dated 25.8.2015, under section 25B I (b)/25D of the Special Powers Act, 1974 was started. 

 4. Police after completion of the investigation submitted charge sheet against the accused appellant and 3 others, vide charge sheet No. 33 dated 25.2.2016, under section 25B 1(b)/25D of the Special Powers Act, 1974. Thereafter, the case record was sent up to the Court of learned Metropolitan Sessions Judge and Senior Special Tribunal, Dhaka wherein it was registered as Metro. Special Case No. 295 of 2016 and ultimately, the case was transferred to the Court of learned Judge, Special Tribunal No. 15, Dhaka for trial and disposal, who framed charge against the accused appellant and others under section 25B 1(b)/25D of the Special Powers Act, 1974 and on 20.3.2017 P.W. 1 was examined and thereafter, in spite of several adjournments the prosecution could not produce any further witness till now. 

 5. The accused-appellant moved for bail on several occasions before the Special Tribunal No. 15, Dhaka where the case is pending for trial but his applications were rejected, for the last time on 19.10.2017. 

 7. Mr. Mir Mohammad Nasir Uddin, the learned Advocate appearing for the accused-appellant submits that the accused appellant is innocent, the allegation as brought against the accused appellant in the first information report is false, who did not involve with the alleged occurrence. He next submits that the accused-appellant was arrested on 25.08.2015 and got bail for a period of 6 months on 31.07.2017 by a Division Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Case No. 23290 of 2016 and he was released on bail on furnishing bail bond and thereafter, according to direction given by the Appellate Division of Bangladesh Supreme Court in Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 784 of 2016 the accused appellant, voluntarily surrendered on 15.01.2017 before the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka and since then he has been languishing in jail-custody without knowing when the trial can be concluded. Ile further submits that other 02 accused persons namely, Abu Taller Ahmed and Kabir Islam standing on the same footing have already been enlarged on bail and it is on record that P.W. 1 was examined long back on 20.3.2017 and thereafter, the prosecution miserably failed to examine any further witness as yet. Finally, the learned Advocate submits that the accused-appellant has been languishing in jail hajot for more than I (one) year and I (one) month, the trial is being delayed without any fault on the part of the petitioner, no one knows when the trial will end and in such position of uncertainty, the accused-appellant deserves to go on bail for the ends of justice. 

 10. It transpires from the record that the accused appellant and 3 others were apprehended by the police from Shah-Jalal International Airport, Dhaka on 24.8.2015 at night 21.20 hours and police on search recovered total 590 gms. Gold ornaments and 156 foreign SIM Cards from accused-appellant and recovered 269 gms. Gold from accused, Abu Taller Ahmed and also recovered 498 gms. Gold, 62 SIM Cards and Mobile set etc. from accused, Kabir Islam. It further transpires from the record that police after investigation submitted charge sheet under section 2513 l(b)/25D of the Special Powers Act, 1974 and thereafter, the case was transferred before the Special Tribunal No. 15, Dhaka for trial and disposal and in the course of trial the prosecution examined only, P.W. 1 on 20.3.2017 and thereafter, the prosecution could not produce any further witness in spite of several adjournments. It further transpires form the record that the accused appellant after being released on bail as per direction of the Appellate Division of Bangladesh Supreme Court voluntarily surrendered before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka on 15.1.2017, who took him into the jail custody by his order dated 15.1.2017 and since then he has been languishing in jail hajot without knowing when the trail can be concluded, co-accused, Kabir has already been enlarged on bail by this Court in Criminal Misc. Case No. 12894 of 2016 on 15.6.2016 and co-accused, Taher Ahmed has also been enlarged on bail by the Metro Sessions Judge on 05.11.2015. 

 12. Considering all the aspects of the case, particularly the accused-appellant after being enlarged on bail as per direction of the Appellant Division of Bangladesh Supreme Court voluntarily surrendered before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka on 15.1.2017, 2 other accused persons are on bail, P.W.1 was .examined long back on 20.3.2017 and thereafter, the prosecution could not produce any further witness as yet, the trial is being unnecessary delayed without any fault on the part of the accused-petitioner, no one knows when the trial will end and in such position of uncertainty, we are inclined to exercise our discretion in granting bail to the accused-petitioner. 

 13. In the result, the appeal is allowed. The accused-appellant, Md. Mahbubur Rahman, son of late Doulat Miah may be released on bail, if he furnishes a bond to the satisfaction of the learned Judge, Special Tribunal No. 15, Dhaka before whom he case is pending for trial. 

 14. However, in case of misuse of the privilege of bail, the Court below is at liberty to cancel the bail at any stage of the case whatsoever.
